text: No tree-cover loss of 0.5 hectares or more was detected within the forest between 2021 and 2025. The evidence supports that the forest remained intact during this period, though changes under 0.5 hectares—especially at edges—might not be captured due to the 30-meter pixel resolution. The asset was confirmed as forest in 2020 (covering 91.77% of the area) and showed no stand-replacing losses afterward. However, this does not rule out minor or edge changes below the detection threshold.
